subject: Request: repurpose SDR headcount to Solutions Engineer - Q3 sprint approval
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: repurpose SDR headcount to Solutions Engineer - Q3 sprint approval

Team,

Requesting approval to repurpose one open SDR headcount (Seattle) into a Solutions Engineer role for Q3 hiring sprint. Rationale below: 

- Customer need: Acme Corp (expanding contract) requires pre-sales SE support on onboarding and a technical champion for integration partners. Deal in late-stage (see HubSpot: ACME-1428) with expected ARR uplift ~$640k ARR over 12 months if we close the expansion.
- Timing: we need to have an SE in market by mid-August to support implementation timelines.
- Compensation ask: propose SE band with base $140k-$155k, OTE $220k-$240k (details in comp_band_proposal.pdf).
- Headcount impact: convert an unfilled SDR req (open since Mar) to this SE req to avoid net headcount increase; recruiting capacity will be reallocated.

Attachments: [Attachment: headcount_request_Q3.xlsx (12KB)], [Attachment: comp_band_proposal.pdf (48KB)].

Asks:
1) Marissa/Tessa — approval to move the headcount and sign off on banding.
2) Vivek — confirm finance OK with reallocation and any one-time ramp funds.
3) Karthik — confirm sales coverage mitigation for SDR territory.

I can circulate a short MAP for the backfill/coverage plan once we have a green light.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
(555) 555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: repurpose SDR headcount to Solutions Engineer - Q3 sprint approval

Rafael — thanks for the note. A few quick clarifying questions before I can sign off: 
- Ramp timeline: what is your expected full productivity date for the SE (months to first billable support / enablement)?
- Quota responsibilities: will this SE carry any capacity for product demos that count toward ACV or will they be strictly technical enablement?
- Comp cap: please make sure the base/O.T.E. ask stays within our Q3 band ceilings — if you need an exception, flag it explicitly.

Loop Recruiting (Hannah) once we confirm band and job profile. I want to avoid over-indexing base vs variable for this role.

Marissa
VP, Global Sales Operations
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: repurpose SDR headcount to Solutions Engineer - Q3 sprint approval

+1 in principle. Rafael — I reviewed the comp_band_proposal.pdf and recommend the following adjustments:
- Tier the band: Base $135k (min) to $155k (max); target comp midpoint at $145k; OTE target $230k.
- Approve a one-time sign-on budget up to $10k for candidates relocating or with counteroffers.
- For highly technical integrations (k8s/custom infra) we should include a $10k bonus at offer stage tied to product-cert completion in first 90 days.

Please align the job description to the SE competency matrix (see playbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HR/pages/SE+conversion+playbook). I'll put a Greenhouse req template in the linked page and ask TA to push candidate outreach once we have finance confirmation.

—Tessa
Head of Solutions Engineering
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: repurpose SDR headcount to Solutions Engineer - Q3 sprint approval

Appreciate the clear rationale. Approve in principle. Couple of operational asks before final sign-off: 
- Coverage: we need a 6-week MAP for SDR territory coverage — propose interim coverage by two senior SDRs and AE shadowing for key mid-market accounts. Rafael, can you draft that and share by EOD Monday (5/31)?
- Forecast impact: update the Q3 bookings cadence in the pipeline model to reflect ACME's expected onboarding timeline (sheet in headcount_request_Q3.xlsx).

Once finance confirms the reallocation (Vivek), I'm fine moving forward.

Karthik
SVP, Americas Sales
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: repurpose SDR headcount to Solutions Engineer - Q3 sprint approval

Rafael — finance OK to reallocate the open SDR headcount to an SE under our headcount flexibility policy, provided the following conditions are met: 
1) Updated forecast with ARR recognition cadence (sheet updated in headcount_request_Q3.xlsx).
2) A one-time ramp/enablement fund of $18,000 will be made available to cover initial training, cert costs, and an up-front customer shadowing stipend. Please include line items in the MAP.
3) TA should open the Greenhouse req using the SE template and tag this as a priority hire.

Attached: [Attachment: finance_approval_memo.pdf (6KB)]

With the above items, final approval granted. Finance will not approve any exceptions to the comp ceiling without escalation to Revenue Ops.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Mills <hannah@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: repurpose SDR headcount to Solutions Engineer - Q3 sprint approval

Thanks all — summary and next steps: 
- Approvals: in-principle approvals received from Marissa, Tessa, Karthik; finance final approval received from Vivek (see finance_approval_memo.pdf).
- MAP: I'll send the 6-week SDR coverage & backfill MAP by EOD Monday (5/31) — will include interim coverage owners and training plan.
- TA: Hannah, please open Greenhouse req RED-1872 (SE — Strategic Accounts) and use comp band: Base $140k-$155k; OTE $220k-$240k; sign-on up to $10k; one-time ramp fund $18k from Finance.
- Timeline: target onsite/technical interview week beginning July 19; offer by Aug 2; start target Aug 16.

I'll drop the final approval doc to HR and update the Confluence playbook link. Rafael out.

--
Rafael Mendes
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
